description.describe_ch: 本課程結合國貿信函、電郵讀寫練習，輔以簡單英語商務模擬案例，建立學生國貿業務相關英文基礎能力。內容包含部份：1.國貿英文學習基本概念；2.基本國貿實務信函寫作3.模擬國外客戶的商務拜訪與接待。
description.describe_eh: This course aims to cultivate the basic English ability for those students who want to do import-export related jobs. The course will combine lecturing, letters and email reading and writings and business drama acting. The course contents will include: a. Basic concepts of learning international trade English; b. Basic principles and writing on letters and emails of international trade; c. A drama acting on how to arrange a business trip for and host foreign customers.
